parts.text: Re-render this exact image at high quality as a crisp, sharp, in-focus 3D claymation figure: matte hand-sculpted plasticine with visible sculpting tool marks and subtle fingerprints, soft studio lighting, clean edges, no blur, no fuzz, no painterly noise, no over-sharpened halos. Keep EVERYTHING identical: same composition and framing, same face, beard, cap, olive vest with the same 8 pins on one side and the other side plain, the baseball-size ball with purple top, white bottom, mask with purple top half and beige bottom half and purple button with white ring, the gold axe, gloves, pose and the orange clay backdrop.
